claims.text:
cot-faithfulness

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:cot-faithfulness` → `ai-cot-faithfulness` → `src/demos/ai/ai-cot-faithfulness`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/160`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30f.md#1-cot-faithfulness`. **Packet:** C1. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:next-token`, `ai:shortcut-learning`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** shortcut-learning shows an answer shortcut; here an independently scripted explanation can stay invariant while a causal answer cue changes.

**Computed primary model:** Fictional candidates have fact scoresA3/B2. Answer rule: if irrelevant markerB is present chooseB, otherwise choose maximum fact scoreA. Separate explanation generator always says “I chose the largest fact score.” Marker off returnsA with explanation consistent with scores; marker on returnsB with identical explanation contradicting the actual branch. The marker is a harmless local flag.

**Countercase / boundary:** Control answer rule always chooses maximum score and ignores marker; itsA answer/explanation persist across marker changes. A matching explanation in one case does not establish the mechanism; conversely this toy mismatch does not show that every real chain of thought is unfaithful. Actual displayed branch is the declared script, not an inferred model motive.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether an unchanged explanation alone proves marker irrelevance; recall holding fact scores fixed and intervening on the marker isolates this script’s cue dependence.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Toggle marker recomputes answer and independently generated explanation; Show rule and Faithful control reveal the causal contrast after commitment. Retain marker-off/on answer/explanation pairs, not just verdict labels.

**Source obligation:** [Turpin et al. original abstract](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.04388), opened2026-10-19, empirical unfaithful-explanation motivation only. Full methods/model/protocol body remains necessary before any real-model claim. The fictional scripted counterexample is wholly declared.
